result.summary: Reviewed git diff main...HEAD. (1) Migration fix: implementation matches lib/letflow/design/iss-0050-drop-legacy-guard-missing-table.md byte-for-byte -- each of the three per-table blocks (groups/users/tenant_role) gets an IF to_regclass(format('%I.<table>', v_tenant.schema_name)) IS NULL ... ELSE <unchanged existing EXECUTE+count check> END IF, reusing the exact to_regclass mechanism the file's own top-of-block idempotency short-circuit already uses. RAISE NOTICE phrasing, naming conventions (v_tenant/v_missing_count/v_all_copied), and IF/ELSE structure are internally consistent with the surrounding guard. The ELSE branches are verified identical to the pre-fix unconditional blocks -- no behavior change for the already-covered case, no new terminal state, purely additive skip-on-doubt path. No gold-plating: no schema/module changes, fix confined to the DO $$ ... $$ block plus a header comment explaining the ISS-0050 addition, as scoped. Decision 0006: not touched or contradicted -- this is a robustness fix to a guard mechanism 0006 §4 already left as an ELIXIR-DEV engineering call (data-copy verification before drop), not a re-decision of D1-D4. (2) test/letflow/engine_test.exs: diffed assertion bodies line-by-line -- only the describe/test name strings changed (shortened per ISS-0049's established fix shape, narrative detail moved into # comments above); every `assert doc =~ ...` line is byte-identical before/after. Genuinely cosmetic, confirmed against docs/issues/ISS-0051.yaml's own account. (3) docs/anti-patterns.md: the new 2026-08-18 (ISS-0051) update is appended as an addendum inside the existing 'TEST-DESIGNER writing narratively-detailed describe/test names...' entry (not a new duplicate section), accurately states the 4th occurrence, file/line/char-count match ISS-0051.yaml, and its 'documentation alone hasn't worked, add a mechanical check' conclusion is a reasonable, non-duplicative addition to the existing entry's guidance.
